toxicities: 人类对莫达非尼的半数致死剂量（LD50）尚未达到。
summary: 一种促进清醒的长效兴奋剂，通常仅用于功能性目的，因为缺乏明显欣快成分。也用于治疗日间嗜睡障碍。
effectsSummary: Modafinil promotes wakefulness and alertness. Increases focus, concentration, and cognitive performance. Mild euphoria in some users. Low abuse potential.
dosageRemark: Effects last 10-12 hours. Take early in the day to avoid sleep disruption.
generalRisks: Headache, anxiety, insomnia, increased heart rate, nervousness. Rare but serious: Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
longtermRisks: Unknown with moderate use. Long-term high-dose use may lead to sleep disruption and psychological dependence.
saferUse: 在当天早些服用以避免失眠。
避免每日使用以预防耐受。
[TBT] Take longer breaks (at least several days) between consumption.
[TBT] The effect of modafinil can last up to 10 hours. Therefore, pay attention to the time of intake.
[TBT] Remember to drink enough water. This can be forgotten during the effect of modafinil.
